instructions: No applicable AGENTS.md found in repository or ancestors; README validation commands apply.
execution_model: Svelte/Vite UI in Tauri; session actor serializes order mutations; independent async artwork search/thumbnail commands. Existing shared search queue concurrency=4, Rust thumbnail semaphore=8. Front gallery replaces 24 choices per page; back gallery appends; previews observed within 600px; append sentinel within 300px.
release: Nix package release Rust thin LTO, codegen-units=1, stripped, tauri/custom-protocol. UI measurements use actual full App.svelte compiled by production Vite with an identical deterministic Tauri transport fixture for both revisions; not a native WebKit or live-network benchmark.
invariants: Identical artwork IDs, names, ordering, DPI, selected query and absolute index; identical selected order output and slot assignments.
All requested result pages and visible image previews complete inside the measured journey; no dropped failures, quality reduction, or measurement-specific application paths.
Retain text search, current-art indication, direct page jumps, previous/next navigation, enlarged previews, retry, Escape, apply locks, stale-response protection, and card-back infinite scrolling.
No changes to Rust validation, disk writes, security policy, dependency versions, image processing, or supported native platform interfaces.
One append search in flight; shared search maximum4 and thumbnail maximum8; queued work drains on completion/close.

visit every row of all 288 options, revisit first row, choose option2; no missing/duplicate IDs; all async work drained

workloads.input: same deck with common back, 1100x820, throttle=4
workloads.required: same complete journey; existing infinite scrolling and back-only replacement retained
correct error recovery, original indices, selected highlight, no cross-query contamination or mutation on cancel

conditions: same IDs and alternating two queries
workloads.required: complete every cycle and drain requests; close/reopen galleries; force GC at cycle5 and20 for leak comparison

boundaries.start: Immediately before opening the gallery; cold and warm setup recorded separately.
boundaries.end: Every specified row has been viewed with decoded thumbnails, first row revisited, option2 applied and gallery closed, and fixture search/thumbnail/mutation queues all idle.
boundaries.primary: Wall-clock milliseconds for the complete browse-and-select journey.
boundaries.secondary: Cumulative page-boundary waits, renderer task CPU time, request counts, image decode completion, frame p95/max/>50ms, peak JS heap and renderer RSS, peak pending requests, result/selection snapshots.

frozen_acceptance.primary: Normal AND demanding cold journey medians improve >=10% AND >=100ms; paired median improvement exceeds 95% bootstrap uncertainty (lower bound >0).
frozen_acceptance.warm: Neither normal nor demanding warm median regresses by more than max(10%,100ms).
frozen_acceptance.noise: Each baseline stratum CV<=15%; otherwise one predeclared follow-up of 6 additional paired trials; still inconclusive => reject.
frozen_acceptance.samples: 6 measured baseline trials per normal/demanding/backs x cold/warm before editing; final6 alternating pairs per stratum in AB/BA order. At most6 extra pairs/stratum if inconclusive.
frozen_acceptance.frames: Candidate p95 frame time <=max(baseline p95*1.25,50ms); fraction of >50ms frames <=baseline+5 percentage points.
frozen_acceptance.resources: Peak renderer RSS <=baseline+160MiB and JS heap <=baseline+32MiB for <=288 real640px previews; CPU task time <=max(baseline*1.25,baseline+100ms). DOM <=loaded choices*16+500.
frozen_acceptance.queues: Peak search active<=4, append<=1, preview active<=8; pending=0 at each end. Request totals no greater than baseline for required pages/images.
frozen_acceptance.sustained: After GC, cycle20 JS heap <=cycle5+8MiB and renderer RSS <=cycle5+64MiB; no pending work, no growth in live gallery DOM after close.
frozen_acceptance.correctness: All existing frontend tests/checks, workspace Rust tests (network checks explicitly excluded), representative output/side-effect assertions, new browser edges, and native optimized startup smoke check pass.

scope_and_stop: One coherent front-gallery append candidate; no unrelated tuning. Stop if targets met. If rejected, preserve only evidence and revert candidate app changes. Resource growth within explicit caps is the measured cost of the user-requested retained scrolling results; no eviction/quality tradeoff is authorized.
measurement_budget: Initial6 trials/stratum; final6 alternating pairs/stratum; optional one6-pair follow-up only. No wall-clock timeout beyond external failure; no speculative second optimization without re-profile.
